intro: Fiji is a parliamentary republic, independent since 1970.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is head of state, elected by parliament; Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka took office in 2022. Parliament has one chamber.

chapters.title: Regional role
text: Fiji hosts the Pacific Islands Forum and the University of the South Pacific.

keyTerms.meaning: A state with an elected head of state.
